label: Osteoporosis / Osteopenia / Low Bone Density
description: Avoid loaded spinal flexion, rotation, and end-range side bending.

label: Pregnancy
description: Modify by trimester; avoid prolonged supine and heavy abdominal flexion after mid-pregnancy.

label: Chronic Low Back Pain (disc herniation, spinal stenosis, spondylolisthesis)
description: Prefer neutral spine stabilization and avoid repetitive flexion or painful movements.

label: Hypertension / Cardiovascular Concerns
description: Avoid inversions and breath-holding; use slow, controlled movement.

label: Knee Issues (arthritis, pain, replacement)
description: Avoid deep loaded knee flexion, painful range, and direct joint pressure.

label: Hip Issues (arthritis, pain, replacement)
description: Use smaller hip ranges and avoid extreme opening or loaded rotation.

label: Neck / Shoulder Issues
description: Avoid unsupported head lifts and excessive shoulder loading.

label: Recent Surgery
description: Get medical clearance first; favor gentle, supported movement and avoid high-risk exercises.

label: Arthritis (general)
description: Respect pain-free range and avoid heavy loading or extreme end-range motions.

label: Scoliosis / Spinal Asymmetry
description: Favor asymmetry-aware posture, avoid aggressive twisting, and prioritize balanced spinal support.

label: Pelvic Floor Dysfunction
description: Focus on pelvic floor-friendly stability and avoid strong Valsalva or uncontrolled abdominal loading.

label: Diastasis Recti / Abdominal Separation
description: Avoid loaded abdominal flexion, intense twisting, and exercises that increase intra-abdominal pressure without support.

label: Shoulder Instability / Impingement
description: Avoid heavy overhead loading, unsupported shoulder weight-bearing, and movements that aggravate shoulder instability.

label: Bursitis / Tendinopathy
description: Avoid repetitive friction, compression, or end-range joint positions around inflamed bursae.

label: Vertigo / Dizziness
description: Avoid rapid head movement, inversions, and unsupported balance work that may trigger dizziness.

label: Diabetes / Metabolic Concerns
description: Use steady movement, monitor intensity, and avoid prolonged strain during blood sugar fluctuation.

label: Postpartum / Postnatal Recovery
description: Focus on gentle core reconnection, pelvic floor recovery, and progressive return to load.

label: Balance / Fall Risk
description: Avoid unsupported balance challenges and progress with stable, grounded movement.

label: Joint Replacement (knee, hip, shoulder)
description: Favor controlled, low-impact movement and avoid high-load joint stress around the replaced joint.

label: Foot / Ankle Issues
description: Avoid high-impact foot loading, excessive plantarflexion, and unsupported ankle instability.

label: Chronic Fatigue / Autoimmune Sensitivity
description: Use gentle pacing, shorter sessions, and avoid pushing through excessive fatigue.

label: Other
description: Get AI-backed guidance for a condition not listed here.
